    Example task: turn a short, wordy sentence into a slide headline.

    Your note

    “The team reduced the time it takes to prepare the weekly report from 3 hours to 1 hour.”

    A suggested headline to aim for

    “Weekly reporting time fell from 3 hours to 1.”

    Check that every number and qualification survives the rewrite.

    Example task: separate progress, concerns and next steps in a longer update.

    Your note

    “The pilot finished on time. Staff still need training, so we should delay the wider rollout.”

    A suggested structure to aim for

    Progress: pilot complete.
    Concern: training incomplete.
    Recommendation: delay expansion.

    Check the meaning and recommendation, especially where notes contain caveats.

    Use your own AI app or agent

    You can use the prompt below in your chosen AI app, then paste its draft into the brief. If it runs in the cloud, that app will receive whatever you send to it.

    Connect an agent with MCP

    A compatible AI app or agent can use the project’s deck tools to review and render a plan. Set up the connection in that app. It does not control this open editor automatically.

    Open connection instructions on GitHub ↗

    A little help at every step.

    1. Brief. Say who the deck is for, the outcome you need and the key information. Try an example if you are unsure.
    2. Edit. Click any text on the slide. Use Add element for a chart, image, table or callout. Select a slide in the left rail to move, duplicate or delete it.
    3. Review. Follow the suggested checks, then use Present to check the whole story. Use the arrow buttons or ← →; press Esc to leave presentation mode.
    4. Save & share. An editable copy keeps your deck and the editor together. A presentation copy is for viewing. Download again after making changes.

    Your notes and images are not uploaded. Browser recovery is a convenience; keep an editable download as your backup.

    Keep a recovery copy here

    Recovery is a convenience, not a file backup. Browser data can be cleared or storage can fill up. Download an editable copy to keep your work.

    First time using the editor offline?
    1. Download an editable copy while you have internet.
    2. Open the saved .html file in a browser. Some mobile file previewers do not run HTML apps.
    3. Turn off Wi-Fi and check that you can edit and save a new copy.

    The editor includes its fonts, code and embedded images. No model is installed or downloaded. File downloads are created on this device and limited to 10 MiB.

    Save a smaller project file

    A JSON project contains your slides and brief. Return to the start screen and choose Open a saved deck to reopen it. It needs a copy of this editor.

    Logo on every slide

    The Hands on Deck icon is a temporary placeholder. You can replace it with your own logo or remove it.

    PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MiB. Your logo is embedded into the editor copy and exported deck for offline use.

    Page numbers

    Title/front and Cover layouts have no page number. Content and Statement slides are numbered from 1. Numbers update when you reorder, add or delete slides.
